No option can be put forward yet: the model could not test the **annual salary spend < £400k/year** limit, so its comparison does not answer your full question.

- The run is **very low robustness** and rests on three Olumi-supplied, unvalidated values; delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption, while onboarding load and annual salary spend also materially shape the result.
- The analysis also assumed that a higher “shipped by Q3” score is preferable; that objective direction was not stated.
- The salary constraint remains recorded but unscored because annual salary spend is modelled as a calculated change, not a salary figure in £/year.

The crucial next reasoning step is to attach the £400k/year limit to comparable salary inputs.
